subject: Capacity buffer request: POC load run (approval pending)
content:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@finexa.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, EngOps <engops@finexa.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity buffer request: upcoming POC spike (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding this week. We have a constrained window next week (Nov 30–Dec 2) where we plan to run a ramped throughput validation of our recommender back-end. The test aims to validate latency and tail latency under a realistic traffic spike — roughly 25k qps peak, ~90s median session, expected total token volume ~1,100,000 tokens across the run.

Our current trial quota won't cover the peak bursts. Would Redwood be able to provide a one-time promotional credit top-up to cover the run? Ideally we need credits applied before EOD Nov 29 so the engineering team can run the scheduled tests.

Quick background: this is a short POC intended to inform our capacity/design decision for production. If results look good we are prepared to move forward with a Dedicated capacity discussion (we already flagged this with procurement).

Attached is a compact load plan and the test schedule. Happy to share more telemetry after the run.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Head of Platform — Finexa
[Attachment: poc-load-plan.xlsx]

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@finexa.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:17:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity buffer request: upcoming POC spike (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the plan and the heads-up.

A few quick clarifying questions so we size the credit appropriately:
- Is the 25k qps a sustained peak for multiple minutes, or a short burst per-minute peak?
- Are you running multi-turn prompts (KV reuse) or single-shot calls? That affects token counts.
- Do you expect many simultaneous long-lived sessions (KV cache heavy)?

If you can confirm those points and re-send the exact test window (UTC), I can triage this with Sales ops and our credits team. Priyom — looping you in for credit sizing and any promotional constraints.

I can escalate for a one-time buffer if we can agree on expected consumption.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@finexa.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: EngOps <engops@finexa.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:11:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity buffer request: upcoming POC spike (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Hi Mina — answering inline:
- Peak profile: 25k qps sustained in 10-minute windows, repeating over 6 hours with 20% background traffic rest of the time.
- Call type: single-shot recommendation calls (no multi-turn), so per-call tokens are small (median ~12 tokens generated).
- Sessions: short-lived; no KV cache reuse.

Schedule (UTC): Dec 1 02:00–08:00 UTC (this aligns with Nov 30–Dec 2 PST schedule).

I've attached the compact load plan we referenced (concurrency matrix + expected token histogram). Let me know if you want a quick 15-min call to walk through it.

Thanks — Olivia
[Attachment: poc-load-plan.xlsx]

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Olivia Grant <olivia@finexa.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:02:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity buffer request: upcoming POC spike (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Thanks for the details, Olivia. Based on the numbers (single-shot, median tokens low, 6 hour window with repeated 10-min peaks) we estimate the run will consume ~750k token-equivalent credits.

Mina — from a promotional standpoint we can provision a one-time "capacity buffer" for POC testing. I need sales approval to apply the credit and confirm billing exemption for any overage tied to this run. Can Connor or finance sign off?

Olivia — if you can confirm that Finexa will accept a short-form credit agreement (I can attach the template), we can get this moved quickly.

Best,
Priyom Das
Growth Ops, Redwood Inference

- Next steps for Finexa: sign the short-form credit agreement (DocuSign link below) if you want the exemption confirmed before the run. If not signed, we will still apply the 750k promotional credit but reserve the right to bill overages.
